facts.fact: Per the Institute of Practitioners in Advertising study cited by the vendor, campaigns balancing brand building with activation delivered 3x better ROI over three years than activation-only approaches.
facts.quote: found that campaigns balancing brand building with activation delivered 3x better ROI over three years compared to activation-only approaches.

facts.fact: The vendor suggests established businesses with steady cash flow consider a 60/40 budget split favoring brand awareness over lead generation.

facts.fact: The vendor suggests newer businesses or those needing quick wins consider a 70/30 budget split favoring lead generation over brand awareness.
facts.quote: Consider a 70/30 split favoring lead generation.

facts.fact: According to the vendor, connected TV ads on networks such as NBC, Hulu, and ESPN can be run starting at $50.
